svg.title: Vindex complete reliability map
svg.desc: Sixteen numbered detail sections cover core upload and jobs, optional indexing and analytics, metrics, backups, and guarantee boundaries. Open the individual sections in the accompanying guide to read the full notes and copy editable Whimsical source.
svg.text: Working-tree implementation · October 26, 2026 · Optional systems labeled · Defaults are not measured recovery times
